create_ImageEncoderViT: create an ImageEncoderViT module for encoding images with configurable patch size and temporal attention
build_Block: build a transformer Block with multi-head attention, MLP, and optional window attention
create_TemporalBlock: create a TemporalBlock that applies temporal attention across video frames
build_PatchEmbed: build a PatchEmbed layer that converts input images into patch embeddings
run_window_partition: run window partition to split spatial feature maps into non-overlapping windows for local attention
